definitions: A visual effect or graphic element that mimics the appearance of a stroke or line drawn quickly by hand, often used for transitions or emphasis.
A design element characterized by an imperfect, gestural line created to look as if it were drawn by hand with a sweeping motion.
examples: The animator used a Hand-Drawn Swipe Stroke to transition between scenes.
The logo incorporated a Hand-Drawn Swipe Stroke for a more organic feel.
A Hand-Drawn Swipe Stroke added dynamism to the infographic.
